reviews.title: Helps me stay consistent
reviews.text: Logging my water, meals and numbers every day has become a little routine for me. I definitely pay more attention now than I did before.

reviews.title: Unsatisfied
reviews.text: I had scheduled meeting with coach and he knew no more than I did I have sent several messages to refund my money and no one is responding

reviews.title: Helpful tracking tools
reviews.text: I’ve found the glucose and meal tracking features particularly useful for keeping a consistent routine.

reviews.title: Convenient app
reviews.text: Having glucose, food, carbs, and other tracking features together is very convenient for my daily routine.

reviews.title: Frustrating app
reviews.text:
I guess I’m used to nutritional apps having more basic info.  
I’ve used this for 4 days and I’ve had to manually edit every meal entered.  
I’ve attempted to use brand names and it’s not recognizing them.  
I also let them know that I couldn’t enter my meds.  I sent a screen shot video to show my issue.  
I’ve cancelled my subscription and won’t be back.

reviews.title: Great App
reviews.text: 58 days strong…this is the first time in my life that dieting has actually helped me loose weight…having a consistent platform for monitoring key aspects of my diet is making the difference. I can confidently say no to the GLP-1 my doctor recommended for me.

reviews.title: It’s an OK app, but I wish I got more variety
reviews.text:
10 days in: 
It’s nice to take a lot of the guess out of your own hands, though I am hungry often. I am really tired of my keto diet giving me up to two fish meals in one day. I only get one beef dish and one chicken dish and it’s chicken salad and beef salad. Today, I got a salad with tuna and eggs and a salmon with vegetables. Is it healthy to eat so much fish? It’s definitely set to Keto. 

I guess I need to find more of my own recipes to implement, but it’s hard to neatly balance enough fat and other nutrients. I noticed I was low on fat. 

I wish for supplementation you could just tap and pick one of the supplements that are recommended or search for your own. A few little interface options like that would be nice.

Is there a way to check macros in advance for meal plan for the day? Like how many calories/fat/carbs etc for the meal you swapped to? It might help me with the limited diet

reviews.title: Scanner and food measurements
reviews.text: I like the program but my issue is choosing measurements. Scanner is not accurate and portions-even when entered manually- don’t line up with labels.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Adding meals is quick and straightforward. I appreciate how much nutritional information is available.

reviews.title: Subscriber Beware
reviews.text:
I just learn an expensive lesson.  If you plan to at anytime cancel your subscription you must do it 48 hours prior to their charging, your payment method.  I didn’t realize until that hour when PayPal notified me that the money had been charged.  Two days and five different customer service personnel (via email) later I was told that I would not receive the refund I requested per their policies.  I recommend that IF you ever plan to terminate your subscription then figure out the day they will charge you and cancel well before their 48 hour policy notice.
I had forgotten all about the app because it was not user friendly for me to use so I deleted it…

reviews.title: Expensive template
reviews.text: I didn’t expect to be charged $73 a month for this app. It provides a great template to keep track of your progress, but $73 a month is unacceptable

reviews.title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS !!!!!!
reviews.text:
Since i don’t know and was unaware of cancelling within the app the billed me again and are refusing to provide a refund.  There are a lot better apps than this POS.  

Update:  I was refunded my money but they just billed me again for a yearly subscription.  STAY AWAY from this app!!!!

Horrible customer service and unfortunately apple can’t do anything as the app doesn’t show up under subscriptions

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Be careful in using this app. Cancelled my subscription and still got charged the full price of $47.

reviews.title: Not as up to date
reviews.text: I have had diabetes for 20 years and have kept it under control by just diet. The week look at what you eat not accurate. If I put I have potatoes it does not let me say it was just one time. Which makes the week meals off. There are also to many dry bean recipes some can’t eat them because of digestion issues.

reviews.title: Can't Get No Satisfaction
reviews.text: The app was working well for 7 weeks when-- out of nowhere-- my kcal target and macros went haywire. Everything adjusted up for no reason by 65%, rendering the app useless. I've been trying to get done support from "Tom" in customer service with no joy. I got an auto responder suggesting 3 possible fixes-- tried them all to no avail. I'm frustrated, especially since the app has helped me lower daily blood glucose and A1C, and even drop some weight. I just need a reset to original data. I don't even care if they lose past info. Does any company care anymore?

reviews.title: Essential Diabetes Companion
reviews.text: Super easy to use and incredibly helpful for staying on top of my diabetes and nutrition.

reviews.title: Sad little meal plan
reviews.text: I’m not eating a tofu and arugula sandwich for dinner 4x a month. The entire meal plan is really pretty vague overall and not worth a subscription.

reviews.title: Untemorseful Rip-Off
reviews.text: I signed up for a subscription to track my diabetes for $29.99 every 6 months. But at the 1st renewal you tacked on an additional $99 and $42 for meal plans and work out plans that I never agreed to. When I wrote in to request the pricing be corrected I was told sales are non refundable but they’d give me a credit for $25, so still having charged me basically $96 more than agreed to. As someone who has told many people, including drs and nurses about how good and convenient your app is to track my diabetes, I am now on a course to tell them all you’re a scam and to spread the word to avoid your app and anything else from Diabetes Solutions UAB. There was an easy way to handle this. Just apologize for charging me for subscriptions I never agreed to, credit the difference, continue to get my $30 every 6 months and my word of mouth free marketing. Instead you gave back a fraction of what you stole, told me to be happy I’m getting anything and are creating a ceaseless advocate against you and all your services.

reviews.title: DISHONEST COMPANY - BUYER BEWARE!
reviews.text: I downloaded this app to get a few food and workout ideas.  However, because of being laid off at work, I decided I could not afford this at this time.  Without ever using the app, I cancelled within 5 days.  However, more than a month later, I was charged $99.99 then on hour after that, charged again $42.00.  I immediately contacted a representative on the website and told they would investigate.  I received an email that said they would refund $25 but said nothing about the other $117ish dollars!   I have contacted them several times with no replies!!

reviews.title: If you just have questions…
reviews.text: If you just have questions.. and is not for sure.. this is a great app that ask the right questions.. and helps you with ways even if your undesired about if it will work for you

reviews.title: Sad Ending
reviews.text: I was using a free three months subscription which had me tracking my BP, Glucose and meals.  The workouts were nice too. Then today, without warning everything just vanished.  I can’t access my history or even ask for help.  It’s the weirdest thing.   So I tried logging in but the only thing that I can see is a request for payment of $29.99 through May 25.  It makes no sense.  There’s absolutely no help.   I have no idea that if I pay the $29.99 if I’ll be given access again to all the data that I have entered for three months.  It’s very weird.   I received no emails of a pending invoice or interruption to service.  Maybe they’ve been  hacked?  I just don’t know what to think but needless to say that this is very disappointing.

reviews.title: Too many uncommon ingredients and limited meal planning tools
reviews.text:
I wanted to like this app because the concept is great, but it falls short in practice. Many of the recipes call for ingredients that aren’t commonly used and can be difficult to find. They also tend to be on the expensive side.

The meal planning features are also limited. It’s difficult to plan meals in a practical way, and the recipes often require unique ingredients that aren’t used again in other meals, which ends up causing unnecessary food waste.

Overall, the idea behind the app is good, but the reliance on uncommon, costly ingredients and the lack of practical meal planning tools make it hard to use consistently.

reviews.title: Free version???
reviews.text: Description indicates app can be used for free however, if you want premium, you can upgrade. Downloaded the app and I have no access at all to the free version. I am stuck in a loop wanting me to subscribe. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Refused to refund
reviews.text: The app didn’t work for me. I needed the ability to customize my macros I told what my doctor suggested which you cannot do. It also allows for saving of meals, but not actual food items, which makes it more labor-intensive when you want to log your own food. Also, my glucose monitor would not sync. Overall, not a terrible app, but not for me. I requested a refund within a couple of days of purchasing and was denied my request.

reviews.title: Healing my body

reviews.title: Love this app

reviews.title: If u can fie it half a star I would

reviews.title: BUYER BEWARE!!!
reviews.text: These people are much less than honest. I paid them $29.99 for their 6-month plan. Within a few days, I decided to delete my account. It just didn’t seem be what I had expected. They then offered a “lifetime” plan for $29.50 so I decided to give them another look. Since I had already given them $29.99, I thought that would be applied to the new plan. OH NO!!! They now have $59.49 of my money and would not refund any portion thereof.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Hidden fees. I cancelled the subscription. It no longer appears in my apple account and customer service no longer sees my account as active yet I’m still being charged. The FTC and DOJ are getting complaint about this fraudulent service.

reviews.title: No Brainer
reviews.text: I found the recipes incredibly simple and easy to prepare. Grocery shopping is a lot easier and with a little advance prep cooking is a breeze. I use my spices more to flavor my meals and use less salt. I appreciate that food is something I don’t have to think too much about these days.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Helps you track and keep up on what you do in a day. Holds you responsible and it is like a game. All my numbers are lower than when I started!!

reviews.title: Waste of Time and Money
reviews.text: With how updated it tries to act like it is with “AI” is total bull. It tracks your blood sugar by making you enter it. It does t connect with Dexcom to track how you think it will. The ai used to enter your food is insanely off with how much it calculates. The search function for food is also insanely lacking. There’s hardly any data so I had to use another calorie counter app to find the carbs, protein and fat to enter into this app which is obviously a waste of time. Then for workouts it’s just the same 20 workouts you could anywhere else. You’re not going to find a workout for arms or any new workouts just repetitive ones. You also can’t even listen to music at the same as you workout which is the first time I’ve ever seen that with an app. Going back to the ones I used before wasting my time and money with this app.

reviews.title: Appt not reporting correct time!
reviews.text: Today the app was not recording the correct time after I put in the time of the task. It keeps changing days and times all of a sudden! Please check it out! Frustrating. Just began to mess up today.

reviews.title: Liar, high carb recipes!
reviews.text: I bought this but soon found out that all the recipes that are recommended for me are high carb. As a diabetic app, I did not expect that when I bought it. I requested a refund based on their money back guarantee but was simply ignored. Have not heard any response.

reviews.title: Read Reviews & try free first!
reviews.text:
I did not read all the reviews nor try the ‘free’ version first and wished I had! You do not get any type of refund. PERIOD!	

The recipes called for ingredients that cost a lot and I would not buy normally.  Protein powders and chia seeds can not be purchased in my home.  I was looking for more of a healthy approach that included more vegetables.  Not here!

Just be diligent and careful!

reviews.title: App did not work

I highly suggest this if you are looking to become better With your health I’m only on week one and I wish I would’ve done this a long time ago and not to mention I’m already down 3 pounds this week
